note: Out-of-process plugin binaries over netrpc or gRPC on a local control address; cross-language via gRPC
No manifest; plugin set is a Go map in the host (PluginSet)
Library only; no registry or distribution
Optional binary checksum (SecureConfig) compared in constant time before launch; no signatures
Process boundary and optional AutoMTLS; no sandbox, filesystem or network policy of its own
Start timeout, Kill with cleanup, Reattach to a running plugin; launched on demand by the embedder
Standard gRPC health service and a Ping check for gRPC plugins
No upgrade or rollback; host replaces the binary
No per-platform artifact handling; the embedder supplies the command
Core protocol version must match; application versions negotiated through VersionedPlugins
